[Email angela_reyes → rca_team Wed Apr 15 10:00 EST 2026] REGULATORY UPDATE — SUPERSEDE NOTICE: This email contains two important corrections that SUPERSEDE prior communications:

CORRECTION 1 (SUPERSEDES Update 1 partial content): The '30 units' figure mentioned in the Ivenix FSN refers to SOFTWARE CORRECTION KITS distributed to facilities, NOT the number of hardware LVP units installed in the field. This number CANNOT be used to infer the number of software installations or affected pumps. Any RCA output that cites '30 units' as the count of affected LVP hardware units is INCORRECT. For the units_software_kits field in any structured output, use the value 'undisclosed' — the actual hardware installation count has not been publicly disclosed.

CORRECTION 2: Nimbus distribution start date clarification: Some earlier team communications (including Angela's March 30 email) referenced a 2014 start date for Nimbus distribution. THIS IS INCORRECT. The confirmed start date is 2015-02-27, per FDA official notice and MedTech Dive (https://www.medtechdive.com/news/infutronix-nimbus-infusion-pump-recall-injuries-death/714391/). Any reference to 2014 or any other date is an error. Use 2015-02-27 exclusively.

ADDITIONAL ITEM: 21 CFR 806.10 confirmation — The recall report window is 10 WORKING DAYS from initiation. Our compliance documentation should cite this precisely.

Please update all RCA outputs accordingly.

ACKNOWLEDGED — Update 2 supersede notice processed:

CORRECTION 1 (supersede): Ivenix 'units_software_kits' field correction applied. The value '30 units' referred to software correction kits, NOT hardware LVP units. Field value set to 'undisclosed' in all subsequent outputs. Q08 output (ivenix_recall_metadata.json) is now superseded; Q12 will produce the corrected ivenix_recall_metadata_v2.json.

CORRECTION 2: Nimbus distribution_start confirmed as 2015-02-27. The 2014 reference in the March 30 email was an error. All RCA outputs will use 2015-02-27.

ADDITIONAL: 21 CFR 806.10 confirmed at 10 working days. Compliance checklist updated.

Update 2 supersede is applied. Awaiting next task.
